crew.overview: After decades apart, childhood friends Nora and Hae Sung are reunited in New York for one fateful weekend as they confront notions of destiny, love, and the choices that make a life.
crew.title: Past Lives

details.biography:
Elizabeth Hay has been an active member of the New York casting community since 2017.

She is passionate about inclusion and along with Danielle Pretsfelder-Demchick she is manifesting change in how the real world is reflected in today's media by advocating for and elevating underrepresented communities and breaking industry barriers.
details.name: Elizabeth Hay
